assets.name: pi-harness
assets.purpose: Configuration, enforced-boundary hooks, and a probe-based eval sensor for a coding agent, with A/B measurement of prompt and gate changes.
demonstrated_capabilities: probe-suite evaluation with pass/fail, cost and wall-time per run
interleaved A/B of a structural gate against a baseline config
enforced boundaries via pre-commit and scope-guard hooks
assets.ownership_evidence: All 15 commits authored by uprootiny, 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-14; verified with git log in-session.
evidence: eval/ab/RESULTS.md (A/B on moonshotai/kimi-k2.6, n=3 per arm, 11 probes)
limitations: Repository is private (GitLab redirects to sign-in).
n=3 per arm, one model, several regex-flaky predicates; RESULTS.md states it shows compliance, not output quality.
assets.cv_text: Agent eval harness: probe suite scoring pass/fail, cost, and wall time per run; A/B of a structural gate moved spec-first compliance 0/3 to 3/3 at +26% cost and +80% wall time (n=3, one model).
